change_summary: Replaced the single fused `ijk` loop with three explicit nested loops using tl.static_range(KH/KW/BLOCK_K_COUNT) to eliminate runtime modulo/division index arithmetic, added maxnreg=128 to all autotune configs to cap register usage and raise occupancy, and expanded configs to include BLOCK_K=32 variants.
